## 1

That sounds really exhausting, and I’m sorry you’ve been dealing with it for so long. Before you make a decision tomorrow, can we talk tonight or take a little time to think through your options? You don’t have to stay in a situation that’s hurting you, but quitting abruptly could create extra stress, so we could look at things like taking leave, speaking with your manager or HR, or lining up another job first. Whatever you decide, you don’t have to figure it out alone.

## 2

I understand why some space images might seem difficult to verify firsthand, but the evidence for a spherical Earth doesn’t depend on photographs alone. Ships disappear over the horizon from the bottom up, different stars are visible at different latitudes, Earth’s shadow on the Moon during lunar eclipses is round, and time zones and satellite communication all fit a globe-shaped Earth. These observations have been made by many independent people and organizations, not just space agencies. It’s reasonable to question evidence, but the simplest explanation that accounts for all of it is that Earth is round.

## 3

Sunlight looks white, but it is actually made of many colors. When sunlight enters Earth’s atmosphere, it bumps into tiny molecules of air. Blue light gets scattered in all directions more strongly than most other colors, so blue light reaches our eyes from across the sky. That is why the sky looks blue when the Sun is high. At sunrise and sunset, sunlight travels through more atmosphere, scattering away much of the blue and leaving more red, orange, and pink light.

雨下了一整夜，细密的水声敲打着窗玻璃，像有人在黑暗中轻轻叩门。街灯被雨幕晕开，昏黄的光落在湿漉漉的路面上，映出摇晃的树影。远处偶尔驶过一辆汽车，轮胎划开积水，短暂地溅起银白色的浪花。屋里很安静，只有墙上的钟慢慢走着。我捧着一杯热茶站在窗前，看雨水沿着玻璃蜿蜒而下，忽然觉得这漫长的夜晚也有一种温柔的安慰。
